description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G} or {W}{W}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Brigid
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Brigid
Repeat.
